diff.title: Show changes
diff.hint: See what changed in your files since the last commit.

files.title: Show files
files.hint: Browse and open the files in this project.

preview.title: Show preview
preview.hint: Open your running site or app in a panel beside the chat.

tasks.title: Show tasks and helpers
tasks.hint: See omp's checklist, its helpers, and background jobs.
tasks.keywords: tasks, todo, checklist, subagents, helpers, jobs

plan.title: Show plan
plan.hint: Read the plan omp wrote for this chat.

outputs.title: Show outputs
outputs.hint: See the images and files omp created, wrote, changed or viewed in this chat.
outputs.keywords: outputs, images, screenshots, renders, generated, pdf, documents, files, written, created, changed, viewed

terminal.title: Show terminal
terminal.hint: Run your own commands in this project.

newShell.title: Open a terminal
newShell.hint: Start another shell in this project.

diff.noProject: Open a project to see its uncommitted changes.
diff.notRepoTitle: This folder isn't a git repository
diff.notRepo: The Changes panel compares files with your last commit, and that needs git.
diff.empty: Edits made since your last commit appear here, whether omp or you made them.
diff.reviewHint: Ask omp to review these changes for bugs (runs /review).
diff.discardBody: The file goes back to how it was at your last commit. You can't undo this.
diff.discardNewBody: This is a new file. It moves to the Trash, so you can still get it back from there.
diff.binary: This is a binary file, so there's nothing to show line by line.
diff.truncated: This change is too big to show here.
diff.noNewline: No newline at end of file
diff.commentHint: Enter to save · Shift+Enter for a new line

files.noProject: Open a project to browse its files.
files.zoomHint: Click or press Enter to zoom in or back out, plus and minus to change the zoom, and 0 to fit the image. Drag or scroll to move around it.
files.mentionHint: {{key}}-click or right-click a file to mention it in chat.
files.revealFolder: Show folder in its parent folder
files.binary: This file isn't text ({{size}}), so it can't be shown here.
files.tooLargeTitle: This file is too big to preview
files.tooLarge: It's {{size}}. Open it in another app to read it.

preview.invalid: Only local addresses (like localhost:3000) and secure https:// pages can open here.
preview.empty: Type a local address above, or start a dev server in this chat to get a link.

tasks.empty: omp's checklist, helpers and background jobs appear here while a chat works.
tasks.tokensHint: How much text this helper has read and written so far.
tasks.messagePlaceholder: It reads this at its next step.
tasks.transcriptOffline: omp isn't running for this chat right now.
tasks.transcriptTimeout: omp didn't answer in time. Try again in a moment.

plan.noChat: Open a chat to see its plan.
plan.off: In plan mode, omp works out an approach and writes a plan here before it changes anything.
plan.waiting: omp is waiting for your decision on this plan
plan.approveHint: omp starts working on this plan.
plan.optionsHint: Opens omp's terminal to refine the plan, keep or compact the context, or save it for later.
plan.checklistHint: The checkboxes in omp's plan file, as omp last saved them.

outputs.noChat: Open a chat to see the images and files omp makes in it.
outputs.empty: Images and files omp creates, writes, changes or views in this chat appear here.

created.title: Created
created.description: Images omp generated and files omp reported adding as new.

written.title: Written
written.description: Files omp wrote or a command saved. Each may be new or may have replaced an existing file.

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: Files that existed before omp edited or wrote them.

viewed.title: Viewed
viewed.description: Images and PDFs omp opened without changing them.

outputs.unavailable: This image could not be displayed.
outputs.pdfUnavailable: This PDF could not be displayed.

terminal.empty: Run your own commands in this project. These shells are separate from omp's.

todo.title: Tasks
todo.created_one: Made a task list with {{count}} task
todo.created_other: Made a task list with {{count}} tasks

summary.title: Files omp changed in this turn
summary.totalsHint: The lines omp's edits added and removed in this turn. Repeated edits to one file all count, so this can differ from the net change.
summary.totalsHintPartial: The lines omp's edits added and removed in this turn, leaving out files omp changed without reporting line counts, such as whole-file writes and structural edits. Repeated edits to one file all count, so this can differ from the net change.
